invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.lead: Bill your tracked time and expenses, send the invoice, and see what is still owed.
invoices.newLead: Bill a client's uninvoiced time and expenses, or start from a blank invoice.

empty.outstanding: Nothing is owed to you right now
empty.body: Create an invoice from your tracked time, or start a blank one.

source.timeHint: Everything billable that is not on an invoice yet, for the period you choose.
source.blankHint: Write the lines yourself, e.g. for a fixed fee or a deposit.

grouping.label: One line per
grouping.detailedHint: Every entry with its date, person and notes.

invoices.nothingToBill: This client has no uninvoiced billable time or expenses in that period.
invoices.voidBody: The invoice keeps its number but is no longer owed. Its time and expenses become uninvoiced again, so you can bill them on a new invoice.
invoices.deleteBody: The draft is removed and its time and expenses become uninvoiced again.
invoices.readOnly: This invoice was imported from Harvest and is read-only.
invoices.paidNotice: Paid in full on {{date}}. A paid invoice can't be changed.
invoices.voidNotice: This invoice is void. It keeps its number but is not owed.
invoices.noLines: No lines yet. Add one below.
invoices.removeLineHint: Its time becomes uninvoiced again when you save.

taxMode.label: Taxes
taxMode.named: Named taxes (sales tax, GST, VAT as a single rate)

vatMode.reverse_charge: Reverse charge (the customer accounts for VAT)

fields.subject: Subject
fields.buyerReferenceHint: The reference your client asked you to quote.
fields.taxNamePlaceholder: e.g. VAT, GST or Sales tax
fields.defaultVatRateHint: Used for new lines in the standard category.
fields.discountHint: Taken off the subtotal before tax.
fields.paymentInstructionsHint: Bank details or other ways to pay, in any format your clients need.

invoices.paidToast: Payment recorded. The invoice is paid.
invoices.sendLead: Sending gives the invoice its number. The client gets the PDF and a link to view it online.

einvoice.title: E-invoice
einvoice.lead: The same invoice in the structured formats that buyers' systems read.
einvoice.first: To make e-invoices from this invoice:
einvoice.afterThat: Ready once the above is done.
einvoice.connectFirst: Connect Peppol sending in Invoice settings to send this invoice straight to the client.

invoiceSettings.title: Invoice settings
invoiceSettings.lead: Defaults for new invoices. Changing them doesn't change invoices that already exist.
invoiceSettings.numberingLead: Invoices get the next number when they are sent or marked as sent. Drafts have none, and a number is never used twice.
invoiceSettings.paddingHint: Leading zeros up to this many digits; 0 for none.
invoiceSettings.termsHint: The due date is this many days after the issue date.
invoiceSettings.notesHint: Printed on every new invoice; you can change it per invoice.
invoiceSettings.footerHint: A line at the bottom of every page, e.g. your company details.
invoiceSettings.bcc: Send me a copy of every invoice I send
invoiceSettings.bccHint: You can change this each time you send.
invoiceSettings.remindersHint: Emails the client on the days below. Reminders stop when the invoice is paid.
invoiceSettings.reminderDaysHint: Negative is before the due date: -3, 0, 7 reminds three days before, on the day, and a week after.
invoiceSettings.einvoicesLead: Invoices carry the EN 16931 data that e-invoicing needs. Download any issued invoice as Factur-X/ZUGFeRD, XRechnung or Peppol BIS from the invoice's menu.
invoiceSettings.hybridActive: On: invoice PDFs carry the XML inside, wherever the invoice has the data. They look and print the same.
invoiceSettings.hybridInactive: Off: invoice PDFs are plain PDFs.
invoiceSettings.contactLead: The contact on your side that e-invoices name. XRechnung needs all three.

publicInvoice.notFound: This invoice link is not valid. Ask the sender for a new one.
publicInvoice.thanks: Thank you. Your payment is being confirmed; this page will show the invoice as paid shortly.

payments.title: Online payments
payments.lead: Let clients pay invoices by card and other methods from the invoice page. Payments go straight to your own Stripe account and the invoice is marked paid.
payments.connectedNotice: Stripe is connected. Invoices you send now offer online payment.
payments.connectError: Stripe was not connected. Start again here, and finish within half an hour in this same browser. Or connect with your own key.
payments.testMode: Test mode: Stripe takes only its test cards, so no money moves. Connect with a live key to take real payments.
payments.webhookUrlHint: In Stripe, the webhook endpoint for checkout.session.completed must point here.
payments.lastError: Stripe reported a problem the last time a client tried to pay: {{error}}
payments.disconnectBody: Invoices will no longer offer online payment. Payments already made stay recorded.
payments.connectLead: Sign in to Stripe and authorise Honest Robin to create payment pages for your invoices. You can disconnect at any time.
payments.keyTitleAlt: Or connect with your own Stripe keys
payments.keyStep1: In Stripe, create a restricted key that can write Checkout Sessions, or use your secret key.
payments.keyStep2: Add a webhook endpoint for the event checkout.session.completed. The address is shown here once you connect; it looks like {{url}}.
payments.keyStep3: Paste the key and the endpoint's signing secret below.
payments.secretKeyHint: Starts with sk_ or rk_. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
payments.noFee: Honest Robin takes no fee on payments. Stripe charges its usual fees on your Stripe account.

peppol.title: Send over Peppol
peppol.lead: Peppol delivers e-invoices straight into your clients' accounting systems, in Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Japan and more. Sending goes through an access point; Storecove is the first one supported.
peppol.platformOffer: Send through Honest Robin's Peppol connection: nothing to sign up for, and what each document costs is passed on as it is.
peppol.orOwn: Or, with a Storecove contract of your own:
peppol.apiKeyHint: From Storecove's dashboard. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
peppol.viaPlatform: Connected through Honest Robin's Peppol connection.
peppol.viaOwn: Connected with your own Storecove contract.
peppol.webhookHint: So that delivery updates come back, add a webhook in Storecove with this address, sending the secret in an X-Webhook-Secret header.
peppol.webhookSecretHint: Send it as the X-Webhook-Secret header.
peppol.notConnected: Peppol sending isn't connected. An admin can connect it.
